create table if not exists useraccesspackage ( id text, target_principalName text, accessPackage_id text );
SELECT useraccesspackage.id, target_principalName as UserName, accessPackagesCatalogs.displayName || '/' || accessPackages.displayName as RoleName FROM useraccesspackage inner join accessPackages on accessPackages.id = useraccesspackage.accessPackage_id inner join accessPackagesCatalogs on accessPackagesCatalogs.id = accessPackages.catalog_id ;
